# Playwright And Storybook

[Back to Workflow Reference](WORKFLOWS.md#playwright-and-storybook)

| Workflow                                                           | Type       | Runner             | Docker | Purpose                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------- | ------------------ | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Playwright Tests](tests-playwright.yml)                           | Reusable   | `ubuntu-latest`    | Yes    | Selects related specs, shards browser tests, and emits optional trusted Sentry/OTel artifacts.                                                                                                                                           |
| [Playwright Credentialed Tests](tests-playwright-credentialed.yml) | Reusable   | `ubuntu-latest`    | Yes    | Trusted credentialed browser specs.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| [Storybook](storybook.yml)                                         | Reusable   | `ubuntu-latest`    | No     | Trusted Storybook snapshots and browser/a11y validation, no Pages artifact and no write credentials; exact same-repository Dependabot/Renovate PRs receive only read-only snapshot and browser/a11y validation at the immutable PR head. |
| [Main CI (storybook)](main-storybook.yml)                          | Standalone | inherited via uses | No     | Runs the reusable validation, then builds and protects one run/attempt-bound `storybook-*` artifact on trusted `main`; the centralized completed-run receiver dispatches its exact source metadata to private infrastructure.            |
